measurement_validity_rules: A deterministic-replay certificate is not safe merely because its digest is bound into an attempt. The trust root deciding which certificate digests are authoritative must not be caller-supplied at the score/reservation API boundary.

The live runtime fingerprint used to authorize a retry must be derived by a context-owned provider at retry time; accepting a caller-provided current fingerprint lets the caller assert away runtime drift.
Authorization objects should be persisted/transported as validated data, not relied on as Python dataclass instances across module reloads/process epochs.
Process epoch HMAC invalidation and deterministic replay authorization are complementary: an old permit must die on restart, and only a newly authorized same-attempt permit may be issued.
FAIL_CLOSED must remain usable without any deterministic replay authority and must not be silently upgraded by a replay contract.
scope_limitations: The v5 trust root is fixed at RuntimeContext construction but the bootstrap mechanism supplying that registry/provider is still outside this artifact. Production use needs a privileged immutable/config-verified bootstrap.
The deterministic scorer in validation was a hash(attempt_id) toy implementing the declared score-level determinism. No LLM runtime determinism certificate was established.
File-identity verification is pre/post filename hashing and is not an adversarial secure loader against a writer racing mutation during a call.
No default runtime was switched; these are forward-only evaluation candidates. FAIL_CLOSED remains the safe active path.
Crash injection for the new v5 end-to-end runtime has not yet been exhaustively rerun at every ADMIT/RESERVE/SLOT/COMMIT/CLOSE byte boundary.
frontier: Run exhaustive torn-tail/crash injection across the v5 trust-rooted lifecycle, especially deterministic replay crash-before-SLOT, SLOT-before-COMMIT reconciliation, and v3 verified CLOSE boundaries.

Make the bootstrap trust root durable and content-addressed: certificate registry generation/digest plus runtime snapshot provider implementation must themselves be verified code/config, not ambient caller objects.
Replace pre/post filename hashing with immutable content-addressed module loading or verified image/package digest to remove the remaining TOCTOU window.

Stress a deliberately stochastic scorer under a falsely trusted certificate to quantify the consequence and make the certificate-trust assumption explicit in release criteria; do not treat registry membership as empirical proof of determinism.
Only after crash/torn-tail and trust-bootstrap checks pass should any integration consider enabling DETERMINISTIC_REPLAY; preserve FAIL_CLOSED as default.
exact_next_action: Crash-test v5 using a fixed privileged registry/snapshot provider: create replay-authorized ADMIT, durable DETERMINISTIC_REPLAY RESERVE, then inject crash/torn writes before/after score, SLOT, COMMIT, and verified CLOSE. Require scorer-call count <=1 before fresh authorized replay, identical protected statistic on authorized replay, no evidence from torn SLOT/CLOSE, and no replay after COMMIT.
